alternative_search.commons_result: Available Tøyen torg Commons files predate 2018 renovation; unsuitable as an unqualified post-redevelopment photo.

alternative_search.rejected_candidate: A 2023 article credits an older pre-renovation Tøyen square image CC BY 2.0; its later publication date is not the capture date.
alternative_search.decision: Do not mislabel dated archive photos as current, or replace documentary photos with synthetic photorealism.

photographic_provenance.illustration_disclosure: Every replacement artwork itself visibly reads 'ILLUSTRASJON · IKKE FOTOGRAFI' and carries metadata marking it as original editorial illustration. Not documentary proof or a true photo of the square.
